potentials.text: For each Terra Trekker on the squad, increases the Skill DMG of Wither Vial by 16%. Instant Blossom (Support Skill) now throws 3 Wither Vials and 4 Rose Vials. The Wither Vial converts adjacent Rose Vials into Wither Vials as well.

potentials.name: Lasting Aftertaste
potentials.brief: Extends the duration of all Vials.
potentials.text: Extends the duration of all Vials by 50%.

potentials.name: Waning Year
potentials.brief: When Wither Vial applies Wither stack to a target that has not yet reached the max stack limit, it deals DMG. For every current stack of Wither on the target, the Skill DMG upon applying a new stack is increased.
potentials.text: When Wither Vial applies Wither stack to a target that has not yet reached the max stack limit, it deals 18.5%/29.7%/40.8%/51.9%/63%/74.1% of Springseek Coronis's ATK as Terra Skill DMG. For every current stack of Wither on the target, the Skill DMG upon applying a new stack is increased by 8%/12%/17%/21%/26%/30%.

potentials.name: Faded Splendor
potentials.brief: For each Wither Vial on the field, increases Wither Vials' Skill DMG.
potentials.text: For each Wither Vial on the field, increases Wither Vials' Skill DMG by 2.6%/4.2%/5.8%/7.4%/9%/10.6%.

potentials.name: Aromatic Room
potentials.brief: When a Rose Vial or Wither Vial is on the field, increases all Terra Trekkers' ATK.
potentials.text: When a Rose Vial or Wither Vial is on the field, increases all Terra Trekkers' ATK by 17%/28%/38%/49%/59%/69%.

potentials.name: Terra Chorus
potentials.brief: When all squadmates are Terra Trekkers, each Rose Vial on the field increases the Terra Mark DMG taken by the target when Springseek Coronis deals Skill DMG.
potentials.text: If all squadmates are Terra Trekkers, when Springseek Coronis deals Skill DMG, each Rose Vial on the field increases the Terra Mark DMG taken by the target by 9.4%/15%/20.6%/26.2%/31.8%/37.4% for 3s.

potentials.name: Herbal Tempering
potentials.brief: Increases the ATK of Springseek Coronis.
potentials.text: Increases the ATK of Springseek Coronis by 20%/32%/44%/56%/68%/80%.

potentials.name: Flying Fire
potentials.brief: Ultimate can inflict Terra Mark: Earth Vein. Increases Springseek Coronis's ATK.
potentials.text: Springseek: Burst of Blaze (Ultimate) can inflict Terra Mark: Earth Vein. Increases Springseek Coronis's ATK by 18%/29%/40%/50%/61%/72%.

potentials.name: Dream Shock
potentials.brief: Increases Ultimate's Ultimate DMG against elite or higher-tier targets. Additionally inflicts Allure on normal targets, dealing DMG when the effect ends.
potentials.text: Increases the Ultimate DMG of Springseek: Burst of Blaze (Ultimate) against elite or higher-tier targets by 29%/46%/63%/81%/98%/115%. Additionally inflicts Allure on normal targets: Lasts 2s, and deals 162%/259%/356%/453%/550%/647% of Springseek Coronis's ATK as Terra Ultimate DMG when the effect ends.

potentials.name: Lingering Grace
potentials.brief: Increases Springseek Coronis's Ultimate DMG. While the Ultimate is on cooldown or its Energy is not full, increases the ATK of Terra Vanguards and Versatile Trekkers in the squad.
potentials.text: Increases Springseek Coronis's Ultimate DMG by 14%/23%/32%/40%/49%/57%. While the Ultimate is on cooldown or its Energy is not full, increases the ATK of Terra Vanguards and Versatile Trekkers by 11%/17%/24%/30%/36%/43%.

potentials.name: United Flame
potentials.brief: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases Springseek Coronis's ATK.
potentials.text: When Springseek: Burst of Blaze (Ultimate) deals DMG, increases Springseek Coronis's ATK by 2.7%/4.3%/5.9%/7.5%/9.1%/10.7% for 20s, stacking up to 6 times.

skills.name: Sonic Bubble
skills.brief: Tap the Main Skill button to switch between weapon modes: Bubble Machine and Megaphone. Both modes continuously fire bubbles to deal DMG. In Bubble Machine mode, inflicts Bubble Mark. Upgrade materials:
skills.text: Tap the Main Skill button to switch between weapon modes. Bubble Machine mode Strike 1 to 3: Deals 82% of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG multiple times. Strike 4: Deals 165% of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG In this mode, Auto Attacks inflict Bubble Mark when dealing DMG. Megaphone mode Strike 1 to 3: Deals 63% of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG multiple times. Strike 4: Deals 167% of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG.

skills.name: Luminous Leaper
skills.brief: When tapping the Main Skill button, different effects occur based on the current Decibels. Current Decibels below 100: Switches back and forth between Bubble Machine and Megaphone modes. Current Decibels at 100: Consumes all Decibels at once and launches a Bubble Frog: every bounce creates an impact dealing AoE Aqua Skill DMG and inflicting Aqua Mark: Torrent. When Bubble Frog deals DMG, increases the squad's ATK. Upgrade materials:
skills.text: When tapping the Main Skill button, different effects occur based on the current Decibels. Current Decibels below 100: Switches back and forth between Bubble Machine and Megaphone modes. Current Decibels at 100: Consumes all Decibels at once and launches a Bubble Frog: every bounce creates an impact dealing 342% of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG and inflicting Aqua Mark: Torrent, bouncing once every 3s. When Bubble Frog deals DMG, increases the squad's ATK by 13.3% for 6s, stacking up to 5 times.

skills.name: Frolic in the Sea
skills.brief: Willow dives into the water, dealing Aqua Skill DMG in a large area and generating a 7m-radius Bubble Bath that continuously deals AoE Aqua Skill DMG. Willow then follows the Main Trekker, slowly firing bubbles that continuously deal Aqua Skill DMG for 17s. All of the above DMG can inflict Aqua Mark: Torrent. While Willow is on the field, she provides different statuses to the squad based on the current Decibels: Gentle Warning: Decibels ≤40, increases Aqua DMG Safety Alert: 40< Decibels ≤100, additionally increases ATK Upgrade materials:
skills.text: Willow dives into the water, dealing 403% of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG in a large area and generating a 7m-radius Bubble Bath that deals 99% of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG every 3s. Willow then follows the Main Trekker, slowly firing bubbles, continuously dealing 62% of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG for 17s. All of the above DMG can inflict Aqua Mark: Torrent. While Willow is on the field, she provides different statuses to the squad based on the current Decibels: Gentle Warning: Decibels ≤40, increases Aqua DMG by 23% Safety Alert: 40< Decibels ≤100, additionally increases ATK by 46%.

skills.name: Beach Warning
skills.brief: Blows multiple bubbles and fiercely hits them consecutively, dealing AoE Aqua Ultimate DMG and inflicting Aqua Mark: Torrent, while increasing the squad's ATK. Upgrade materials:
skills.text: Blows multiple bubbles and fiercely hits them consecutively, dealing 479%x7 and 839% of ATK as AoE Aqua Ultimate DMG, inflicting Aqua Mark: Torrent, while increasing the squad's ATK by 11.5% for 20s, stacking up to 5 times.

potentials.name: Bubble Flurry
potentials.brief: In Bubble Machine mode, targets with Bubble Mark generate absorbable bubbles. After absorbing them, Bubble Frog grows in size, and the Skill DMG it deals increases.
potentials.text: In Bubble Machine mode, targets with Bubble Mark periodically generate absorbable bubbles. Each bubble absorbed by Bubble Frog enlarges it by 10%, while also increasing the Skill DMG dealt by Bubble Frog by 5%. It can grow up to 100% in size.

potentials.name: Rippling Radiance
potentials.brief: In Bubble Machine mode, Bubble Frog deals Aqua Skill DMG to nearby targets over time while increasing their Aqua DMG Taken and inflicting Aqua Mark: Torrent.
potentials.text: In Bubble Machine mode, Bubble Frog deals 52.3% of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG every second to nearby targets, while increasing their Aqua DMG Taken by 4% for 8s, stacking up to 4 times. Can inflict Aqua Mark: Torrent.

potentials.name: Clustered Foam
potentials.brief: In Bubble Machine mode, bubbles deal additional AoE Aqua Skill DMG. Can inflict Aqua Mark: Torrent. Increases the Aqua DMG dealt by all Aqua Trekkers against targets with Bubble Mark.
potentials.text: In Bubble Machine mode, bubbles deal an additional 17.1%/27.4%/37.7%/47.9%/58.2%/68.5% of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG. Can inflict Aqua Mark: Torrent. Increases Aqua DMG dealt by all Aqua Trekkers against targets with the Bubble Mark by 4.6%/7.3%/10.1%/12.9%/15.6%/18.4%.

potentials.name: Enduring Bubble
potentials.brief: When Willow and Bubble Frog deal DMG to targets with Bubble Mark, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken.
potentials.text: When Willow and Bubble Frog deal DMG to targets with Bubble Mark, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken by 2%/3.2%/4.4%/5.6%/6.8%/8% for 5s, stacking up to 5 times.

potentials.name: Dreamlike Illusion
potentials.brief: When a squadmate triggers Aqua Mark or inflicts Aqua Mark: Torrent on targets with Bubble Mark, increases all Aqua Trekkers' Skill DMG in the squad.
potentials.text: When a squadmate triggers Aqua Mark or inflicts Aqua Mark: Torrent on targets with Bubble Mark, increases all Aqua Trekkers' Skill DMG in the squad by 1.6%/2.6%/3.6%/4.6%/5.6%/6.6% for 6s, stacking up to 6 times.

potentials.name: Rhythmic Bubbles
potentials.brief: In Megaphone mode, increases Bubble Frog's bounce frequency and Skill DMG. Each bounce grants additional Decibels.
potentials.text: In Megaphone mode, increases Bubble Frog's bounce frequency by 100% and Skill DMG by 50%. Each bounce grants 5 additional Decibels.

potentials.name: Rainbow Rebound
potentials.brief: In Megaphone mode, Bubble Frog unleashes Echoing Soundwave when bouncing, which can echo multiple times, dealing Aqua Skill DMG and increasing the target's DMG Taken of all Elements. This DMG can inflict Aqua Mark: Torrent. The Attack Range of Echoing Soundwave increases based on the current Decibels.
potentials.text: In Megaphone mode, each bounce of Bubble Frog unleashes Echoing Soundwave that echo 3 times, dealing 14.5% of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG and increasing the target's DMG Taken of all Elements by 1.8% for 5s, stacking up to 8 times. This DMG can inflict Aqua Mark: Torrent. For every 10 current Decibels, increases the Attack Range of Echoing Soundwave by 5%.

potentials.name: Wavering Glow
potentials.brief: After bouncing a certain number of times, Bubble Frog deals Aqua Skill DMG in a large area. Can inflict Aqua Mark: Torrent, while increasing the target's DMG Taken of all Elements.
potentials.text: Every 2 bounces, Bubble Frog deals 21.9%/35%/48.1%/61.2%/74.3%/87.5% of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG in a large area. Can inflict Aqua Mark: Torrent, while increasing the target's DMG Taken of all Elements by 2.1%/3.5%/4.8%/6.1%/7.4%/8.7% for 5s.

potentials.name: Foam Echo
potentials.brief: When Echoing Soundwave deal DMG, increases own and non-Aqua Squadmates' ATK.
potentials.text: When Echoing Soundwave deal DMG, increases own and non-Aqua Squadmates' ATK by 2.3%/3.7%/5.1%/6.5%/7.9%/9.3% for 5s, stacking up to 8 times.

potentials.name: Touch 'n' Bounce
potentials.brief: Each time Bubble Frog bounces, increases the squad's Skill DMG. Additionally, increases non-Aqua Squadmates' Skill DMG.
potentials.text: Each time Bubble Frog bounces, increases the squad's Skill DMG by 1.2%/2%/2.7%/3.5%/4.2%/5%. Additionally, increases non-Aqua Squadmates' Skill DMG by 1.7%/2.8%/3.8%/4.9%/5.9%/7%. This effect lasts 2.5s, stacking up to 8 times.

potentials.name: Cumulus Drift
potentials.brief: Increases Bubble Frog duration, and while it is on the field, increases the squad's ATK.
potentials.text: Increases Bubble Frog duration by 3s, and while it is on the field, increases the squad's ATK by 10%/16%/22%/28%/34%/40%.

potentials.name: Singing Shores
potentials.brief: Can dodge one more time. After Willow dodges, increases own ATK.
potentials.text: Increases Dodge count by 1. After Willow dodges, increases ATK by 15%/24%/33%/42%/51%/60% for 8s.

potentials.name: Ocean Wanderer
potentials.brief: When Bubble Frog deals DMG, Willow gains a shield.
potentials.text: When Bubble Frog deals DMG, Willow gains a shield equal to 32.1%/51.5%/70.8%/90.1%/109.4%/128.7% of Base ATK for 6s. This effect can only be triggered once every 10s.

potentials.name: Tidal Warning
potentials.brief: Increases Ultimate DMG. After casting the Ultimate, generates additional Decibels for a period of time.
potentials.text: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Beach Warning (Ultimate) by 33%/53%/73%/93%/113%/133%. After casting the Ultimate, Willow gains 3 additional Decibels every 1.5s, up to a total of 30 Decibels.

potentials.name: Shore Regulation
potentials.brief: When casting the Ultimate, increases the squad's ATK.
potentials.text: When casting Beach Warning (Ultimate), increases the squad's ATK by 10%/17%/23%/29%/35%/42% for 25s.

potentials.name: Marine Justice
potentials.brief: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken.
potentials.text: When Beach Warning deals DMG, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken by 2.7%/4.3%/5.9%/7.6%/9.2%/10.8% for 20s, stacking up to 5 times.

potentials.name: Flying Droplets
potentials.brief: Gentle Warning gains additional stat bonuses from Safety Alert. For every 10 shots fired by Willow while under Gentle Warning, she fires a straight-line water column attack that deals Aqua Skill DMG and increases Decibels, while applying Smiling Sanction and Aqua Mark: Torrent.
potentials.text: Gentle Warning gains additional stat bonuses from Safety Alert. For every 10 shots fired by Willow while under Gentle Warning, she fires a straight-line water column attack that deals 427%x3 of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG and increases Decibels by 30, inflicting Smiling Sanction and Aqua Mark: Torrent.

potentials.name: Flooding Shore
potentials.brief: When Decibels ≥40, consumes Decibels to fire a rotating water jet, dealing AoE Aqua Skill DMG and inflicting Smiling Sanction and Aqua Mark: Torrent.
potentials.text: When Decibels ≥40, immediately consumes 40 Decibels to launch a rotating water jet attack, dealing 204%x3 of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG, inflicting Smiling Sanction and Aqua Mark: Torrent.

potentials.name: Hovering Gale
potentials.brief: When a target with Smiling Sanction has Aqua Mark triggered, this target is immediately inflicted with Aqua Mark: Torrent again and receives additional Aqua Mark DMG. The Mark DMG received this time is increased based on the stacks of Smiling Sanction.
potentials.text: When a target with Smiling Sanction has Aqua Mark triggered, this target is immediately inflicted with Aqua Mark: Torrent again and receives an additional 118%/189%/261%/332%/403%/474% of ATK as Aqua Mark DMG. For each stack of Smiling Sanction this target has, increases the Mark DMG received this time by 2.1%/3.4%/4.6%/5.9%/7.1%/8.4%. This effect can only be triggered once every 1.5s.

potentials.name: Words Unchanged
potentials.brief: When entering with the Support Skill, the DMG from diving into the water also inflicts 1 stack of Smiling Sanction. Increases the max stack limit of Smiling Sanction, and additionally increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken.
potentials.text: When entering with Frolic in the Sea (Support Skill), the DMG from diving into the water also inflicts 1 stack of Smiling Sanction. The max stack limit of Smiling Sanction is increased to 7/8/9/10/11/12 stacks, and each stack additionally increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken by 0.5%/0.8%/1.1%/1.4%/1.7%/2%.

potentials.name: Eternal Tide
potentials.brief: While Gentle Warning is active, additionally increases the squad's Aqua DMG, and the Main Trekker generates extra Decibels when dealing DMG.
potentials.text: While Gentle Warning is active, increases the squad's Aqua DMG by an additional 12%/19%/26%/33%/40%/47%; the Main Trekker generates 8 extra Decibels when dealing DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

potentials.name: Rhythm Surge
potentials.brief: Increases initial Decibels upon entering the field. At full Decibels, increases the squad's Crit Rate, while continuously consuming Decibels to rapidly fire bubbles.
potentials.text: Initial Decibel upon entering the field equals 70. At 100 Decibels, increases the squad's Crit Rate by 10% for 14s, while consuming Decibels over time to rapidly fire bubbles until Decibels drop to 50.

potentials.name: Thunderous Surf
potentials.brief: Increases Decibels gained from shots. While Safety Alert is active, bubbles turn into sonic waves, increasing DMG Multiplier and the target's Aqua DMG Taken.
potentials.text: Increases Decibels gained per shot from 2 to 4. While Safety Alert is active, bubbles turn into piercing sonic waves, increasing DMG Multiplier by 50%, and increasing the target's Aqua DMG Taken by 1.1% for 8s, stacking up to 16 times.

potentials.name: Prismatic Bubbles
potentials.brief: For every certain number of shots fired by Willow, a blue bubble is generated near targets inside Bubble Bath, dealing AoE Aqua Skill DMG, while increasing the squad's Crit Rate. When a blue bubble is generated, there is a chance it turns into a red bubble, additionally increasing Main Trekker's ATK.
potentials.text: For every 8 shots fired by Willow, a blue bubble is generated near targets inside Bubble Bath, dealing 41%/65%/89%/114%/138%/163% of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG, while increasing the squad's Crit Rate by 5%/8%/11%/14%/17%/20% for 9s. When a blue bubble is generated, there is a 50% chance it turns into a red bubble, additionally increasing Main Trekker's ATK by 19%/30%/41%/52%/63%/74% for 9s.

potentials.name: Engulfing Tide
potentials.brief: Bubble Bath expands over time. When the Main Trekker is inside Bubble Bath, increases her Aqua DMG.
potentials.text: Bubble Bath expands by 5% every second, up to 30%. When the Main Trekker is inside Bubble Bath, increases her Aqua DMG by 18%/28%/39%/49%/60%/70%.

potentials.name: Receding Echoes
potentials.brief: Consuming Decibels increases the squad's Crit DMG.
potentials.text: Each time Decibels are consumed, increases the squad's Crit DMG by 0.6%/1%/1.3%/1.7%/2%/2.4% for 9s, stacking up to 16 times.

potentials.name: Balmy Surf
potentials.brief: Each Aqua Trekker in the squad increases the squad's DEF PEN.
potentials.text: Each Aqua Trekker in the squad increases the squad's DEF PEN by 9/14/19/24/29/34.

potentials.name: Prismatic Barrier
potentials.brief: After staying in Bubble Bath for a period of time, the Main Trekker gains a shield.
potentials.text: The Main Trekker inside Bubble Bath gains a shield equal to 45%/60%/75%/90%/105%/120% of Willow's Base ATK every 5s for 4s.

potentials.name: Tender Seas
potentials.brief: When Willow is on the battlefield, increases the squad's ATK.
potentials.text: When Willow is on the battlefield, increases the squad's ATK by 10%/17%/23%/29%/35%/42%.

potentials.name: Tidal Warning
potentials.brief: Increases Ultimate DMG. After casting the Ultimate, generates additional Decibels for a period of time.
potentials.text: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Beach Warning (Ultimate) by 33%/53%/73%/93%/113%/133%. After casting the Ultimate, Willow gains 3 additional Decibels every 1.5s, up to a total of 30 Decibels.

potentials.name: Shore Regulation
potentials.brief: When casting the Ultimate, increases the squad's ATK.
potentials.text: When casting Beach Warning (Ultimate), increases the squad's ATK by 10%/17%/23%/29%/35%/42% for 25s.

potentials.name: Marine Justice
potentials.brief: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken.
potentials.text: When Beach Warning deals DMG, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken by 2.7%/4.3%/5.9%/7.6%/9.2%/10.8% for 20s, stacking up to 5 times.

skills.name: Honed Sword Art
skills.brief: Wields the greatsword and longsword to deal continuous attacks. When farther away from the target, Firstlight Noya performs a sprint attack with the longsword. Increases the DMG multiplier dealt by Firstlight Noya's Auto Attacks against targets with Glimmer. Upgrade materials:
skills.text: Wields the greatsword [Daybreak] and the longsword [Dawn] to deal continuous attacks. Strike 1: Swings the greatsword, dealing 125% x2 of Max HP as Lux Auto Attack DMG. Strike 2: Swings the greatsword, dealing 130% x3 of Max HP as Lux Auto Attack DMG. Strike 3: Swings the greatsword, dealing 185% x2 of Max HP as Lux Auto Attack DMG. Strike 4: Swings the longsword and fires 2 Glows, each dealing 60% of Max HP as Lux Skill DMG. When Firstlight Noya is farther away from the target, her Auto Attacks become a sprint attack with the longsword, dealing 85% x3 of Max HP as Lux Skill DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 1.5s. When Firstlight Noya's Auto Attacks deal DMG to a target with Glimmer, each stack of Glimmer on the target increases the DMG multiplier of this attack by 12%.

skills.name: Storm Flash: Radiance
skills.brief: Rapidly swings the longsword to deal DMG multiple times, then slams down with the greatsword to deal AoE DMG and generate Starfall. The Main Skill can trigger Lux Mark. Upgrade materials:
skills.text: Rapidly swings the longsword [Dawn], dealing 102% x5 of Max HP as AoE Lux Skill DMG. Then slams down with the greatsword [Daybreak], dealing 180% of Max HP as AoE Lux Auto Attack DMG, and generates 1 Starfall that deals 64% of Max HP as AoE Lux Auto Attack DMG. Storm Flash: Radiance (Main Skill) can trigger Lux Mark to generate Lucent: deals of Max HP as AoE Lux Mark DMG and inflicts 1 stack of Glimmer.

skills.name: Thunderstrike: Break
skills.brief: Spins rapidly with the longsword, then thrusts the greatsword into the ground to create shockwaves, dealing AoE DMG. The Support Skill can trigger Lux Mark. Upgrade materials:
skills.text: Spins rapidly with the longsword [Dawn], dealing 145% x8 of Max HP as AoE Lux Skill DMG. Then thrusts the greatsword [Daybreak] into the ground to create continuous shockwaves, dealing 150% x6 and 257% of Max HP as AoE Lux Auto Attack DMG. Thunderstrike: Break (Support Skill) can trigger Lux Mark to generate Lucent: deals of Max HP as AoE Lux Mark DMG and inflicts 1 stack of Glimmer.

skills.name: Empyrean Starender
skills.brief: Firstlight Noya's Ultimate has two forms, attacking with the greatsword [Daybreak] and the longsword [Dawn] respectively to deal large AoE DMG. When casting the Ultimate, Firstlight Noya gains Starender: increases Crit Rate. The Ultimate can trigger Lux Mark. Upgrade materials:
skills.text: Firstlight Noya's Ultimate has two forms, attacking with the greatsword [Daybreak] and the longsword [Dawn] respectively. She enters battle with the greatsword-form Ultimate by default. Greatsword Form: Leaps into the air and swings the greatsword, dealing 605% x5 and 756% of Max HP as AoE Lux Auto Attack DMG in a large area. Longsword Form: Dashes quickly and attacks at high speed, dealing 153% x7 of Max HP as AoE Lux Skill DMG in a large area, then generates a field that deals 305% x7 of Max HP as AoE Lux Skill DMG in a large area. When casting Empyrean Starender (Ultimate), Firstlight Noya gains Starender: increases Crit Rate by 20% for 30s. Empyrean Starender (Ultimate) can trigger Lux Mark to generate Lucent: deals of Max HP as AoE Lux Mark DMG and inflicts 1 stack of Glimmer.

potentials.name: Lucent Blitz
potentials.brief: Storm Flash: Radiance (Main Skill) unleashes more longsword attacks and fires multiple Glows at the target.
potentials.text: Storm Flash: Radiance (Main Skill) unleashes 4 more longsword attacks and fires 9 Glows, each Glow dealing 21% of Max HP as Lux Skill DMG.

potentials.name: Dawnflare
potentials.brief: Firing a certain number of Glows grants Firstlight Noya Radiance Flurry (Special Main Skill), which deals AoE DMG. Longsword sprint attacks during Auto Attacks now fire multiple Glows.
potentials.text: Firing a total of 17 Glows grants Radiance Flurry (Special Main Skill): swings the longsword to unleash a massive blade light that deals 134% x6 of Max HP as Lux Skill DMG and can trigger Lux Mark. Longsword sprint attacks during Auto Attacks now fire 3 Glows, each dealing 21% of Max HP as Lux Skill DMG.

potentials.name: Prism Warp
potentials.brief: Glows fired by Firstlight Noya return to deal DMG. Increases the Skill Crit Rate dealt by Firstlight Noya's longsword attacks and Glows.
potentials.text: Glows fired by Firstlight Noya return to hit targets, dealing 16%/25%/35%/44%/53%/63% of Max HP as Lux Skill DMG. Increases the Skill Crit Rate dealt by Firstlight Noya's longsword attacks and Glows by 3.7%/6%/8.2%/10.5%/12.7%/15%.

potentials.name: Resolve: Blitz
potentials.brief: Casting the Special Main Skill switches Firstlight Noya's Ultimate to the longsword form. Her longsword attacks and Glows deal increased DMG multiplier to targets with Glimmer.
potentials.text: Casting Radiance Flurry (Main Skill) switches Firstlight Noya's Ultimate to the longsword form. Her longsword attacks and Glows deal 4.5%/7.2%/9.9%/12.6%/15.3%/18% more DMG multiplier to targets with Glimmer.

potentials.name: Lucent Tide
potentials.brief: Glows can trigger Lux Mark and have a chance to gain increased Attack Range. Casting the Main Skill increases Firstlight Noya's Skill Crit Rate and Lux Versatile Trekkers' Skill Crit DMG.
potentials.text: Glows can trigger Lux Mark and have a 50% chance to gain increased Attack Range. Casting the Main Skill increases Firstlight Noya's Skill Crit Rate by 1.8%/3%/4.1%/5.2%/6.3%/7.5% and Lux Versatile Trekkers' Skill Crit DMG by 7.5%/12%/16.5%/21%/25.5%/30% for 12s, stacking up to 2 times.

potentials.name: Stardust Descent
potentials.brief: Storm Flash: Radiance (Main Skill) attacks generate multiple Starfalls. Auto Attack sprints become greatsword attacks that generate Starfalls. Firstlight Noya triggering a Mark also generates Starfalls. All Starfalls deal AoE DMG.
potentials.text: Storm Flash: Radiance (Main Skill) attacks additionally generate 2 Starfalls. Auto Attack sprints become greatsword attacks that deal 89% of Max HP as Lux Auto Attack DMG and generate 1 Starfall. Firstlight Noya triggering a Mark generates 1 Starfall, and this effect triggers only once every 1s. The above Starfalls deal 23% of Max HP as AoE Lux Auto Attack DMG.

potentials.name: Sinbreaker
